diagnostics.diagnose_listing_matches_desc: Enter a listing ID to see whether it is being offered to members as a match, and why.
diagnostics.diagnose_user_matches_desc: Enter a member's ID to see what is, or is not, stopping them getting matches.
diagnostics.failed_to_load_nexus_score_analytics: Failed to load NEXUS score analytics
diagnostics.matching_diagnostic_desc: Run a diagnostic on specific users or listings to understand match scores
diagnostics.nexus_score_analytics_desc: View analytics for NEXUS scores across your member base
diagnostics.no_diagnostic_data_found_for_this_listin: No diagnostic data found for this listing
diagnostics.no_diagnostic_data_found_for_this_user: No diagnostic data found for this user
diagnostics.score_factors_desc: Score factors are weighted signals used to calculate member engagement.
diagnostics.user_prompt: Enter a user ID and click Diagnose to see their matching analysis.
diagnostics.finding_matching_off: Smart matching is switched off for this community, so nobody gets matches.
diagnostics.finding_member_not_active: This member's account is not active, so they are left out of matching.
diagnostics.finding_matching_paused: This member has paused their own matching.
diagnostics.finding_no_active_listings: This member has no active offers or requests, so they only see general suggestions, not matches.
diagnostics.finding_no_location_remote_only: This member has not set a location, so they are only matched with things that can be done remotely.
diagnostics.finding_no_location: This member has not set a location, so distance cannot be used when matching them.
diagnostics.finding_needs_coordinator_approval: A coordinator has to approve this member's matches before anyone is introduced.
diagnostics.finding_approval_state_unknown: We could not check whether a coordinator has to approve this member's matches.
diagnostics.finding_listing_not_active: This listing is not active, so it is not offered as a match.
diagnostics.finding_owner_not_active: The member who posted this does not have an active account, so the listing is not offered as a match.
diagnostics.finding_listing_not_approved: This listing is waiting for review or was not approved, so it is not offered as a match.
diagnostics.finding_owner_dormant: The member who posted this has not been active for more than {{days}} days, so the listing is not offered as a match.
diagnostics.finding_no_location_in_person: This is an in-person listing and neither it nor its owner has a location, so members who have set a location are not matched with it.
diagnostics.fact_listings_in_moderation: Of those, awaiting or refused by moderation
diagnostics.fact_cached_matches: Matches on record for them now
diagnostics.fact_members_cached: Members it is matched with now
diagnostics.value_dismissals: {{total}} in all, {{recent}} in the last 90 days
